name: Voicenotes
description: Voicenotes captures your thoughts by voice and automatically transcribes and organizes them. With this integration, you can search across all your notes, get full details on any recording, and even create new notes without leaving Claude. Perfect for quickly pulling up ideas, meeting notes, or anything you've spoken into Voicenotes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voicenotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voicenotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.voicenotes.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voicenotes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voicenotes provides these MCP tools: get-note-detail-tool, list-notes-tool, search-notes-tool, and create-note-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voicenotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Voicenotes in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Voicenotes requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voicenotes is developed by Voicenotes. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
